en.title: HUD Implements New Deadline for Fair Housing Accessibility Complaints
en.summary: HUD has introduced a new deadline for filing Fair Housing Act accessibility complaints, aiming to streamline the process but raising concerns about reduced time for victims of disability discrimination to seek redress. Meanwhile, agencies released spatial data for barrier-free walking, launched 16 accessible seaside experiences across Taiwan, opened an assistive-technology mart in Gujarat, and highlighted accessibility efforts at Milan Fashion Week and a local museum’s Sensory Sundays program.

zh-TW.title: HUD 設定公平住房無障礙投訴新期限
zh-TW.summary: HUD 新規定對公平住房法無障礙投訴設定截止日期，旨在簡化流程但引發對殘疾歧視受害者尋求救濟時間縮短的擔憂。空間數據發布支援無障礙步行、海委會啟動全臺16場無障礙親海體驗、ALIMCO 在古吉拉特邦開設輔助技術商店、米蘭時尚週及地方博物館的感官友好星期日等無障礙措施。
